## ALDI opens at Pine Tree Shopping Center


A major milestone for Pine Tree Shopping Center and the state of Maine.


The opening of Maine’s first ALDI introduces a best-in-class grocery option and everyday essentials, strengthening the center as a true daily needs destination.


This first to market opening reflects our commitment to bringing high demand retailers and long term value to the communities we serve.
